verdict.rationale: DBOS explicitly documents long-running human-in-the-loop pauses ('a human might take hours or days to respond to an agent, so the agent must be able to reliably wait for a long time') backed by durable workflow checkpointing/recovery, workflow handles to await results, and send/notify messaging to signal a running workflow to resume it. This directly matches the story of pausing for hours/days and resuming on external input. missing for 10: no independent/hands-on case study specifically demonstrating a multi-day human-approval pause-and-resume in production, and no detail on timeout/escalation handling for very long waits.
